market_summary: US stocks rallied on strong tech earnings despite broader market volatility. Apple beat Q4 expectations with record revenue and iPhone sales, while the SpaceX-Tesla merger remains under exploration with no formal announcement. Meta faces UK regulatory scrutiny over AI content terms. Singapore's STI fell 1.4% recently as local banks declined ahead of Q3 earnings releases scheduled for early November, with inflation stable at 2.2%.

items.headline: Apple beats Q4 2026 earnings: revenue $114.48B vs $113.39B estimates, iPhone revenue $57.58B
items.summary: Apple reported fiscal Q4 2026 revenue of $114.48 billion, beating estimates of $113.39 billion. EPS came in at $2.10 per share, topping the $1.98 estimate. iPhone revenue hit $57.58 billion versus $56.49 billion expected.

items.headline: Tesla-SpaceX merger talks continue: both companies form independent committees to explore deal
items.summary: Both Tesla and SpaceX have formed special committees of independent directors to explore a potential merger as of early November 2026. No terms have been agreed and no formal announcement has been made, though Barclays predicts possible announcement by end of 2026.

items.headline: UK opens competition investigation into Meta's AI content terms for publishers
items.summary: The UK's Competition and Markets Authority opened an investigation on October 30 into Meta's commercial terms allowing use of publisher content for AI development without adequate choice. Meta paused implementation originally planned for November 20.

items.headline: Singapore banks face Q3 2026 earnings test; STI falls 1.4% as local banks decline
items.summary: Singapore's three major banks (DBS, OCBC, UOB) prepare to release Q3 2026 results in early November after a recent market pullback. DBS reports November 5, OCBC on November 6, with UOB expected mid-November.
